messages:
Tara N: Quick heads-up — our partner wants to run a joint POC for APAC with a CN-facing tenant. They flagged cross-border SSO certs + potential egress billing to their VPC.
Samir K: Oof — two big asks. Do we have an accepted pattern for CN region SSO?
Maya R: We usually recommend SAML brokered via partner IdP and keep tokens scoped to the private tenant. Need to confirm cert chain and metadata URLs.
Dmitri P: For the private tenant we can deploy in their cloud region, but that triggers different egress/network pricing. Can you share expected traffic shape?
Tara N: They're starting with ~10k inference requests/day, avg 400 tokens per request during evaluation. Might spike to 100k/day if good.
Alice-BizOps: Pricing note — hosted per-token pricing + outbound egress for dedicated/private differs. For a customer-hosted VPC we pass-through cloud egress costs. I can draft a sample estimate.
Samir K: Also need to answer security questionnaire Q12 about SAML cert rotation and HSM key storage. @compliance-bot any recommended phrasing?
compliance-bot: Suggested answer for Q12: "Redwood supports SAML 2.0 with rotating signing certificates; private key material may be stored in customer-managed KMS/HSM for Private deployments."
Maya R: We'll need a short runbook for the partner: steps to upload SAML metadata, required claim mapping (email, org, role), IP allowlist, and a test user flow. I can draft tomorrow.
Dmitri P: Network constraints: partner requires static outbound IPs for egress -> we'll need NAT + firewall entries. Ops: provisioning lead time ~3 business days once tenant approved.
Tara N: Action items: 1) Alice to produce cost est for both hosted + private (include egress delta). 2) Maya to draft SSO runbook + sample SAML metadata. 3) Samir to complete security answers & add key rotation language. 4) Dmitri to note infra lead time and static IP requirements.
Alice-BizOps: I'll put a spreadsheet together and include a banded estimate for the 10k vs 100k/day scenarios, include reserved capacity pricing options.
Samir K: I'll update the questionnaire and add a snippet for cert rotation cadence (90 days) and KMS integration steps.
Maya R: Draft runbook will include `metadata.xml` example + mapping table. Will ping for review.
Dmitri P: I'll create a minimal network diagram and the exact CIDR/IPs we can provide.
Tara N: Great — can we target a partner update EOD Friday PST? They need answers before legal review next week.
Alice-BizOps: EOD Fri works for the estimate.
Samir K: Questionnaire done by Friday AM for review.
Maya R: Runbook draft by Friday noon.
Dmitri P: Network diagram by Friday afternoon.
Tara N: Thanks team. I'll also set up a quick 30-min sync with partner on Thurs 10am SGT — calendar invite coming. :+1:
Alice-BizOps: Adding pricing rows for: hosted, dedicated reserved, private w/egress passthrough, and a sample commitment.
Samir K: If we hit blockers on cert chain, tag @security so they can bless the metadata.
Maya R: I'll include a `curl` example for the SAML health check and a link to the SSO template: https://redwood.internal/docs/sso-templates (private link).
Tara N: Deploy bot: please record tenant request when ready.
compliance-bot: Note: If partner requires data residency in CN, legal will require a CLA addendum.
Tara N: Noted. I'll coordinate legal if they confirm residency requirement.
Samir K: Thanks all — I'll consolidate answers into one doc to hand to the partner. :rocket:
